id-20260916-news-1.title: National Wage Council Proposes New Formula for 2027 Provincial Minimum Wage Increase, Labor and Employers Still Differ in Numbers

segments.src: Pembahasan Upah Minimum Provinsi (UMP) 2027 kembali menjadi sorotan setelah Dewan Pengupahan Nasional mengajukan skema perhitungan baru yang disebut lebih mempertimbangkan kondisi ekonomi di masing-masing daerah.
segments.tr: The discussion on the 2027 Provincial Minimum Wage (UMP) has once again become a spotlight after the National Wage Council proposed a new calculation scheme that is said to better consider economic conditions in each region.

segments.src: Formula ini muncul setelah perdebatan awal soal besaran kenaikan upah tahun depan memicu tanggapan beragam dari kalangan pekerja maupun dunia usaha.
segments.tr: This formula emerges after initial debates regarding the magnitude of next year's wage increase sparked mixed responses from workers and the business world.

segments.src: ## Formula Baru: Inflasi Daerah dan Produktivitas Jadi Variabel Utama
segments.tr: ## New Formula: Regional Inflation and Productivity Become Main Variables

segments.src: Berbeda dari pendekatan sebelumnya yang cenderung menyeragamkan angka kenaikan secara nasional, formula yang diajukan kali ini menitikberatkan pada dua variabel utama, yaitu tingkat inflasi di tingkat provinsi atau kabupaten/kota, serta produktivitas tenaga kerja di sektor-sektor unggulan daerah tersebut.
segments.tr: Different from the previous approach which tended to standardize the increase figure nationally, the formula proposed this time focuses on two main variables, namely the inflation rate at the provincial or regency/city level, and labor productivity in the region's leading sectors.

segments.src: Dengan pendekatan ini, daerah dengan inflasi tinggi dan pertumbuhan produktivitas yang signifikan berpotensi mendapatkan penyesuaian upah yang lebih besar dibandingkan daerah lain.
segments.tr: With this approach, regions with high inflation and significant productivity growth have the potential to get a larger wage adjustment compared to other regions.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, wilayah dengan tekanan inflasi rendah namun produktivitas stagnan kemungkinan akan menerima kenaikan yang lebih moderat.
segments.tr: Conversely, areas with low inflationary pressure but stagnant productivity are likely to receive a more moderate increase.

segments.src: Menurut penjelasan yang disampaikan Dewan Pengupahan Nasional, tujuan utama dari perubahan formula ini adalah menciptakan mekanisme pengupahan yang lebih mencerminkan realitas ekonomi lokal, sekaligus menjaga daya saing dunia usaha di masing-masing wilayah.
segments.tr: According to the explanation delivered by the National Wage Council, the main goal of this formula change is to create a wage mechanism that better reflects local economic realities, while maintaining the competitiveness of the business world in each region.

segments.src: ## Serikat Buruh: Kenaikan Dinilai Belum Cukup
segments.tr: ## Labor Unions: The Increase is Considered Not Enough

segments.src: Di sisi lain, sejumlah kalangan serikat pekerja menilai formula baru tersebut belum sepenuhnya menjawab kebutuhan hidup layak pekerja, terutama di tengah tekanan biaya hidup yang terus meningkat.
segments.tr: On the other hand, a number of labor union circles assess that the new formula does not fully answer the workers' decent living needs, especially amidst the continuously rising cost of living pressure.

segments.src: Mereka mendorong agar komponen kebutuhan hidup layak (KHL) tetap menjadi acuan utama, bukan hanya inflasi dan produktivitas semata.
segments.tr: They urge that the decent living needs (KHL) component remains the main reference, not just inflation and productivity alone.

segments.src: Sejumlah elemen buruh juga menyoroti pentingnya keterlibatan pekerja secara lebih luas dalam proses perumusan formula, mengingat dampak kebijakan ini akan dirasakan langsung oleh jutaan pekerja di berbagai sektor.
segments.tr: A number of labor elements also highlighted the importance of broader worker involvement in the formula formulation process, considering the impact of this policy will be directly felt by millions of workers in various sectors.

segments.src: ## Kalangan Pengusaha: Perlu Ruang bagi Keberlangsungan Usaha
segments.tr: ## Business Circles: Need Space for Business Sustainability

segments.src: Sementara itu, kalangan pengusaha melalui asosiasi-asosiasi industri mengingatkan bahwa kenaikan upah yang terlalu tinggi berisiko membebani biaya produksi, khususnya bagi sektor padat karya yang masih dalam proses pemulihan pascatantangan ekonomi global.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, business circles through industry associations remind that a wage increase that is too high risks burdening production costs, especially for labor-intensive sectors that are still in the process of recovery after global economic challenges.

segments.src: Mereka meminta agar formula baru tetap memperhitungkan kemampuan bayar perusahaan (ability to pay) sebagai salah satu variabel penting, agar kebijakan pengupahan tidak berdampak pada penurunan daya saing maupun potensi pengurangan tenaga kerja.
segments.tr: They ask that the new formula continues to take into account the company's ability to pay as one of the important variables, so that the wage policy does not impact a decrease in competitiveness or potential workforce reduction.

segments.src: ## Proses Masih Berlanjut
segments.tr: ## The Process is Still Ongoing

segments.src: Hingga saat ini, angka pasti kenaikan UMP 2027 belum diputuskan secara final.
segments.tr: Until now, the exact figure for the 2027 UMP increase has not been finally decided.

segments.src: Dewan Pengupahan Nasional dikabarkan masih membuka ruang dialog lanjutan antara perwakilan pekerja, pengusaha, dan pemerintah daerah sebelum formula tersebut ditetapkan sebagai acuan resmi.
segments.tr: The National Wage Council is reported to still open space for further dialogue between worker representatives, employers, and regional governments before the formula is established as an official reference.

segments.src: Publik, khususnya para pekerja dan pelaku usaha, diimbau untuk terus memantau perkembangan resmi dari pemerintah maupun dinas ketenagakerjaan setempat, mengingat keputusan akhir mengenai UMP 2027 berpotensi memengaruhi kondisi ekonomi rumah tangga sekaligus iklim usaha di berbagai daerah pada tahun mendatang.
segments.tr: The public, especially workers and business actors, are urged to continue monitoring official developments from the government and local manpower offices, considering that the final decision regarding the 2027 UMP has the potential to affect household economic conditions as well as the business climate in various regions in the coming year.

id-20260916-news-2.title: Economic Losses Due to Forest Fire Smoke Estimated to Reach Trillions of Rupiah, Aviation and Exports Hit Hardest

segments.src: Perpanjangan status siaga darurat kabut asap di sejumlah wilayah Kalimantan Barat kembali menyoroti besarnya biaya ekonomi yang harus ditanggung akibat kebakaran hutan dan lahan (karhutla) musiman.
segments.tr: The extension of the emergency alert status for smoke haze in several areas of West Kalimantan has once again highlighted the massive economic costs that must be borne due to seasonal forest and land fires (karhutla).

segments.src: Selain berdampak pada kesehatan masyarakat, kabut asap pekat yang menurunkan jarak pandang juga mulai mengganggu aktivitas penerbangan, rantai pasok logistik, hingga hubungan dengan negara tetangga.
segments.tr: In addition to impacting public health, the dense smoke haze that reduces visibility has also begun to disrupt aviation activities, the logistics supply chain, and relations with neighboring countries.

segments.src: ## Penerbangan Terganggu, Jarak Pandang Jadi Kendala Utama
segments.tr: ## Flights Disrupted, Visibility Becomes Main Obstacle

segments.src: Jarak pandang yang memburuk akibat asap membuat sejumlah maskapai terpaksa menunda atau membatalkan jadwal penerbangan di bandara-bandara yang terdampak.
segments.tr: The worsening visibility caused by the smoke has forced several airlines to delay or cancel flight schedules at affected airports.

segments.src: Pembatalan dan penundaan penerbangan tidak hanya merugikan operator maskapai dari sisi operasional, tetapi juga menimbulkan efek berantai bagi penumpang, pelaku usaha pariwisata, dan sektor jasa pendukung bandara seperti transportasi darat dan perhotelan.
segments.tr: Flight cancellations and delays not only harm airline operators from an operational standpoint, but also create a ripple effect for passengers, tourism business actors, and airport supporting service sectors such as land transportation and hospitality.

segments.src: Pengamat transportasi menilai gangguan semacam ini, jika berlangsung dalam waktu lama, dapat menurunkan kepercayaan wisatawan maupun pelaku bisnis terhadap keandalan konektivitas udara di wilayah yang terdampak asap.
segments.tr: Transportation observers assess that disruptions of this kind, if they persist for a long time, can reduce the confidence of tourists and business actors in the reliability of air connectivity in regions affected by the smoke.

segments.src: ## Rantai Pasok dan Ekspor Ikut Terimbas
segments.tr: ## Supply Chain and Exports Also Affected

segments.src: Selain sektor penerbangan, gangguan kabut asap juga berpotensi merembet ke aktivitas logistik dan distribusi barang, khususnya komoditas ekspor unggulan dari wilayah penghasil seperti karet dan produk perkebunan lainnya.
segments.tr: Apart from the aviation sector, the smoke haze disruption also has the potential to spread to logistics and goods distribution activities, particularly flagship export commodities from producing regions such as rubber and other plantation products.

segments.src: Keterlambatan pengiriman akibat gangguan transportasi dapat berdampak pada kepatuhan jadwal kontrak dengan mitra dagang di luar negeri.
segments.tr: Delivery delays caused by transportation disruptions can impact compliance with contract schedules with overseas trading partners.

segments.src: Sejumlah pelaku usaha di daerah terdampak mengaku mulai mewaspadai potensi kerugian tambahan berupa biaya operasional yang membengkak, mulai dari penundaan pengiriman hingga kebutuhan alat pelindung diri bagi pekerja di lapangan.
segments.tr: Several business actors in the affected regions admitted they are starting to be wary of potential additional losses in the form of swollen operational costs, ranging from delivery delays to the need for personal protective equipment for workers in the field.

segments.src: ## Keluhan dari Negara Tetangga
segments.tr: ## Complaints from Neighboring Countries

segments.src: Kabut asap lintas batas turut memicu keluhan dari sejumlah negara tetangga di kawasan yang kualitas udaranya ikut terdampak.
segments.tr: Cross-border smoke haze has also triggered complaints from a number of neighboring countries in the region whose air quality has been similarly affected.

segments.src: Isu kabut asap lintas negara bukan hal baru dan kerap menjadi perhatian dalam forum kerja sama regional terkait lingkungan hidup, mengingat dampaknya yang dapat memengaruhi hubungan diplomatik maupun citra kawasan di mata dunia usaha internasional.
segments.tr: The issue of transboundary smoke haze is not new and frequently becomes a focus in regional cooperation forums related to the environment, given its impact which can affect diplomatic relations and the region's image in the eyes of the international business community.

segments.src: ## Potensi Kerugian Ekonomi
segments.tr: ## Potential Economic Losses

segments.src: Berdasarkan pengalaman pada musim-musim karhutla sebelumnya, sejumlah kalangan memperkirakan potensi kerugian ekonomi akibat kabut asap dapat mencapai angka triliunan rupiah apabila kondisi tidak segera membaik.
segments.tr: Based on experience from previous forest fire seasons, several circles estimate that the potential economic losses due to smoke haze can reach figures in the trillions of rupiah if conditions do not improve soon.

segments.src: Perhitungan tersebut umumnya mencakup akumulasi kerugian dari sektor penerbangan, pariwisata, produktivitas kerja yang menurun akibat gangguan kesehatan, hingga potensi penurunan nilai ekspor.
segments.tr: Such calculations generally include the accumulation of losses from the aviation sector, tourism, declining work productivity due to health disruptions, to potential declines in export values.

segments.src: Meski angka pasti kerugian masih bersifat perkiraan dan dapat berubah tergantung durasi serta intensitas kabut asap, banyak pihak sepakat bahwa dampak ekonomi dari bencana asap musiman ini selalu signifikan dan berulang setiap tahun jika penanganan karhutla tidak dilakukan secara tuntas.
segments.tr: Although the exact figure of losses is still an estimate and can change depending on the duration and intensity of the smoke haze, many parties agree that the economic impact of this seasonal smoke disaster is always significant and repeats every year if forest fire handling is not carried out thoroughly.

segments.src: ## Upaya Penanganan Terus Berjalan
segments.tr: ## Handling Efforts Continue

segments.src: Pemerintah daerah bersama instansi terkait dilaporkan terus melakukan upaya pemadaman, termasuk melalui operasi darat dan dukungan modifikasi cuaca, guna mempercepat pemulihan kualitas udara.
segments.tr: Local governments together with related agencies are reported to be continuously carrying out firefighting efforts, including through ground operations and weather modification support, in order to accelerate the recovery of air quality.

segments.src: Masyarakat di wilayah terdampak juga diimbau untuk mengurangi aktivitas di luar ruangan dan menggunakan masker guna meminimalkan risiko gangguan kesehatan pernapasan selama masa siaga darurat berlangsung.
segments.tr: The public in affected areas is also urged to reduce outdoor activities and use masks to minimize the risk of respiratory health disruptions during the emergency alert period.

segments.src: Sinergi antara pemerintah, pelaku usaha, dan masyarakat dinilai menjadi kunci utama untuk menekan kerugian ekonomi sekaligus mempercepat pemulihan kondisi lingkungan pascakabut asap.
segments.tr: Synergy between the government, business actors, and the community is considered the main key to suppress economic losses while accelerating the recovery of environmental conditions post-smoke haze.

id-20260916-news-3.title: Danantara Completes State-Owned Insurance Merger, Capital Combined to Chase Global Ranking

segments.src: Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara) dilaporkan telah menuntaskan tahap penting dalam proses konsolidasi perusahaan asuransi milik negara.
segments.tr: The Daya Anagata Nusantara Investment Management Agency (Danantara) has reportedly completed an important stage in the consolidation process of state-owned insurance companies.

segments.src: Sejumlah entitas asuransi pelat merah yang sebelumnya berjalan sendiri-sendiri kini digabungkan menjadi satu perusahaan yang lebih besar, dengan tujuan memperkuat struktur permodalan sekaligus mendongkrak posisi tawar di industri asuransi nasional.
segments.tr: A number of state-owned insurance entities that previously operated independently are now being merged into a single larger company, with the aim of strengthening the capital structure while boosting bargaining position in the national insurance industry.

segments.src: ## Bagian dari Agenda Perampingan BUMN
segments.tr: ## Part of the SOE Streamlining Agenda

segments.src: Langkah penggabungan ini tidak berdiri sendiri.
segments.tr: This merger step does not stand alone.

segments.src: Ini merupakan kelanjutan dari agenda besar perampingan jumlah Badan Usaha Milik Negara (BUMN) yang sudah bergulir beberapa waktu terakhir.
segments.tr: This is a continuation of the grand agenda of streamlining the number of State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) that has been rolling out recently.

segments.src: Pemerintah, melalui Danantara sebagai lembaga pengelola investasi negara, ingin memastikan BUMN yang jumlahnya banyak namun tersebar dengan skala kecil-kecil bisa diringkas menjadi entitas yang lebih efisien dan kompetitif.
segments.tr: The government, through Danantara as the state investment management institution, wants to ensure that SOEs, which are numerous but scattered on a small scale, can be reduced into more efficient and competitive entities.

segments.src: Di sektor asuransi, kondisi ini terasa cukup mendesak.
segments.tr: In the insurance sector, this condition feels quite urgent.

segments.src: Selama ini, beberapa perusahaan asuransi negara beroperasi dengan modal yang relatif terbatas jika dibandingkan pemain swasta maupun asing yang sudah memiliki skala regional atau global.
segments.tr: So far, several state insurance companies have operated with relatively limited capital compared to private or foreign players who already have a regional or global scale.

segments.src: Dengan digabungkan, aset dan modal yang tadinya terpecah di beberapa entitas kini bisa disatukan sehingga kapasitas menanggung risiko (underwriting capacity) menjadi lebih besar.
segments.tr: By merging, the assets and capital previously split across several entities can now be unified so that the underwriting capacity becomes larger.

segments.src: ## Alasan di Balik Penggabungan
segments.tr: ## Reasons Behind the Merger

segments.src: Ada beberapa pertimbangan utama yang mendasari keputusan ini:
segments.tr: There are several main considerations underlying this decision:

segments.src: - **Penguatan permodalan.** Modal gabungan memungkinkan perusahaan hasil merger menopang polis bernilai besar tanpa terlalu bergantung pada reasuransi dari luar negeri.
segments.tr: - **Capital strengthening.** Combined capital allows the merged company to support high-value policies without relying too much on reinsurance from abroad.

segments.src: - **Efisiensi operasional.** Struktur organisasi, sistem teknologi informasi, dan jaringan distribusi yang tadinya tumpang tindih antarperusahaan bisa dirampingkan sehingga biaya operasional lebih terkendali.
segments.tr: - **Operational efficiency.** Organizational structures, information technology systems, and distribution networks that previously overlapped between companies can be streamlined so that operational costs are more controlled.

segments.src: - **Daya saing di pasar global.** Dengan modal dan aset yang lebih besar, entitas gabungan berpeluang lebih baik untuk bersaing dengan perusahaan asuransi multinasional, sekaligus membuka peluang menggarap segmen korporasi dan proyek strategis nasional yang membutuhkan kapasitas penjaminan besar.
segments.tr: - **Competitiveness in the global market.** With larger capital and assets, the combined entity has a better chance of competing with multinational insurance companies, while opening up opportunities to work on corporate segments and national strategic projects that require large underwriting capacity.

segments.src: - **Kepatuhan terhadap ketentuan modal minimum.** Regulator di sektor jasa keuangan secara bertahap menaikkan ambang batas modal minimum bagi perusahaan asuransi. Konsolidasi menjadi salah satu jalan yang dinilai lebih realistis dibandingkan setiap entitas mencari suntikan modal sendiri-sendiri.
segments.tr: - **Compliance with minimum capital requirements.** Regulators in the financial services sector are gradually raising the minimum capital threshold for insurance companies. Consolidation is considered one of the more realistic paths compared to each entity seeking capital injections on its own.

segments.src: ## Dampak yang Perlu Diperhatikan
segments.tr: ## Impacts to Note

segments.src: Bagi nasabah, penggabungan semacam ini umumnya tidak serta-merta mengubah polis yang sudah berjalan.
segments.tr: For customers, this kind of merger generally does not immediately change ongoing policies.

segments.src: Namun demikian, proses integrasi sistem, layanan klaim, dan jaringan kantor cabang biasanya membutuhkan waktu penyesuaian.
segments.tr: However, the process of system integration, claim services, and branch office networks usually requires adjustment time.

segments.src: Nasabah dan mitra bisnis diimbau untuk terus memantau informasi resmi dari perusahaan terkait mengenai kelanjutan layanan pascamerger.
segments.tr: Customers and business partners are urged to continue monitoring official information from related companies regarding the continuation of post-merger services.

segments.src: Di sisi industri, konsolidasi BUMN asuransi juga berpotensi mengubah peta persaingan di pasar domestik.
segments.tr: On the industry side, the consolidation of state-owned insurance also has the potential to change the competition map in the domestic market.

segments.src: Perusahaan asuransi swasta dan pelaku industri jasa keuangan lain kemungkinan akan mencermati bagaimana entitas baru ini memposisikan diri, terutama dalam segmen asuransi korporasi, proyek infrastruktur, dan produk yang selama ini menjadi andalan asuransi pelat merah.
segments.tr: Private insurance companies and other financial service industry players will likely observe how this new entity positions itself, especially in the corporate insurance segment, infrastructure projects, and products that have been the mainstay of state-owned insurance.

segments.src: ## Langkah Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Next Steps

segments.src: Proses konsolidasi semacam ini biasanya masih memerlukan sejumlah tahapan lanjutan, termasuk penyesuaian izin usaha, harmonisasi produk, serta evaluasi berkelanjutan dari otoritas pengawas jasa keuangan.
segments.tr: This kind of consolidation process usually still requires a number of subsequent stages, including business license adjustments, product harmonization, and ongoing evaluation from the financial service supervisory authority.

segments.src: Publik dan pemangku kepentingan di industri asuransi diperkirakan akan terus mengikuti perkembangan lanjutan dari langkah strategis Danantara ini, mengingat perannya yang semakin sentral dalam pengelolaan aset dan investasi negara di berbagai sektor strategis.
segments.tr: The public and stakeholders in the insurance industry are expected to continue following the further developments of Danantara's strategic step, given its increasingly central role in the management of state assets and investments in various strategic sectors.
